relationships.subject: FBXO7
relationships.evidence_quote: FBXO7 physically interacts with interleukin-6 (IL-6) and functions as an E3 ubiquitin ligase targeting IL-6 for K48-linked ubiquitination specifically at lysine 114

relationships.subject: FBXO7
relationships.evidence_quote: This ubiquitination suppresses IL-6-mediated activation of the JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway, which is crucial for maintaining cartilage homeostasis.

relationships.subject: FBXO7
relationships.evidence_quote: FBXO7 overexpression significantly reduced chondrocyte apoptosis and senescence while enhancing proliferation and preserving matrix homeostasis by increasing type II collagen and decreasing MMP13 expression.

key_findings: FBXO7 is downregulated in OA cartilage and ubiquitinates IL-6 (K48, K114)
FBXO7 suppresses IL-6/JAK1/STAT3 and protects against OA in mice
